mapper.select: SELECT cal_date as calendarDate, content as content FROM calendar WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND cal_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (WEEKDAY(CURDATE())) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (6 - WEEKDAY(CURDATE())) DAY)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calendar (user_id, cal_date, content) VALUES (#{userId}, CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(#{day}, 2, '0')), #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT cal_date AS calendarDate, content FROM calendar WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND cal_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND DATE_ADD(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 6 DAY)
